name: Pin & Paper
avoid_for: Decks that need to feel digital-native polished or rigorously data-driven — handwritten Caveat is intentionally informal
weak_cases: Too little source material leaves empty cards; mandatory-looking annotations must not invent personal voice.
visual_signature: Cream cards on yellow, hard blue lift, tilted safety pins and marginal handwriting.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Handwriting is a significant dependency; substitutions can lose the notebook voice and require a new emphasis treatment.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
